name: Responsibility assignment is accepted and completed by the recipient with attribution
description: Owner requests Leo; Leo accepts and completes; History attributes both events to Leo.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Click 'Add responsibility', type 'TS pick up prescription' in 'What needs doing?', choose Kind 'Errand' and save
Verify the responsibility detail shows status 'Unassigned'
Click 'Request assignment', choose 'Leo (demo)' as the household member and confirm
Open 'Sample controls', click 'Open recipient role' and open the 'Continue as Leo in a separate tab' link
Open the responsibility 'TS pick up prescription' and click 'Accept responsibility', then confirm 'Accept responsibility'
Verify History shows 'Responsibility completed' attributed to 'Leo (demo)'
Verify History shows 'Responsibility assignment accepted' attributed to 'Leo (demo)'
